review_candidates.title: Junior Electrical Tender Engineer (UPS and critical power)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: To find out more about us, check: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=baa_aiJ4L7E The key function of this role is to support project tenders from initial review through final quotation to ensure maximum Eaton content that meets the needs of the project. This role will require interpreting the technical packages (drawings, specifications) to identify where Eaton's offers fit and to ensure alignment including agreed CDE's (Comply-Deviate-Exceptions) for all the technical aspects of a tender.
